_comment: Unglazed terracotta: a red-orange earthenware clay fired low and left bare (flower pots, roof and floor tiles, architectural cladding), matte and porous. Opaque: a solid, rough dielectric. Param-only (L1): Physically Based 'Terracotta' gives the colour, the roughness and the IOR; a plain fired body reads at this scale without a texture. Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): chipped edge wear (overlay 1, damage) and dust as a deposit (Phase10), gated by the Crevice mask (chips in broken patches, dust in the recesses). No third layer is relevant. Not carried: the efflorescence (a pale salt bloom) the wish list also wants, which needs a colour deposit layer. Built by the Phase11 batch.
name: Terracotta_Unglazed_Clean_Base_s01_v01
